title: [Bug] Auto-Compact Triggering Excessively with Minimal Changes
body:
**Bug Description**
Claude is in a loop continuously compacting over and over again after only a very small number of changes.

**Environment Info**
- Platform: linux
- Terminal: gnome-terminal
- Version: 2.0.14
- Feedback ID: 5dc7e978-f983-435b-bc2f-59f1b516fba6
